newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C Bank confirms dollar sales.
newsitem.headline: Manila C Bank confirms dollar sales.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank confirmed on Monday it was selling dollars at 26.40 pesos.
However, it did not disclose the amount.
Traders said offshore funds were selling pesos after a Singaporean newspaper quoted Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo saying the peso may devalue against the U.S. dollar.
"I think the Secretary was misquoted," the central bank official said. "We'll sell as long as there are requirements."
De Ocampo was not immediately available for comment.
The Central Bank decided early on Monday to offer one-day reverse repos at 30 percent to crush speculation over the peso.
The peso had traded at 26.40 pesos, with volume heavy at $209 million after an hour of trades.
